about: Quiksilver Surf School Newquay is based in Pentire, about 100 metres from Fistral Beach, and is affiliated with Quiksilver and Roxy. It runs beginner to intermediate group lessons, private and family sessions, coasteering and equipment hire, and hosts women-only surf weekends with Newquay Women's Surf Club.
offers: Beginner, improver and intermediate group lessons
where: 9 Esplanade Road, Pentire, Newquay TR7 1PS, about 100 metres from Fistral Beach
goodToKnow: Full-length wetsuit and board included with lessons
Indoor changing rooms, hot showers and secure lockers
